method: GitHub plugin official-source read-only review plus local SentencePiece target count
scope: Downstream fine-tuning examples, not pretraining or statistical industry sample

repair_budget.stage: new language_warmup; all language attention LoRA trial; vision MEM and expert frozen

limits: Examples differ in domain and starting language capability
Donut scores are tree/field metrics, not native JSON or EOS
SmolVLM and Qwen examples are recipes, not evidence of completed JSON success
Dataset sizes and thresholds for RM65-B are local budgets, not paper-proven minima
KI-FM does not anchor VLM gradients; use explicit KV anchor for language retention
retention_policy: Full-layer updates need pre-calibrated tolerances and paired old-task evaluation; no exact-equality requirement.
